description: This Rust source file defines data structures, parsing functions, and tests for handling Vehicle Safety Specification (VSS) data in JSON format. It includes deserialization of VSS entries, conversion to internal types, and functions to parse VSS data from strings or readers, with a focus on extracting hierarchical vehicle data entries.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a VSS entry with fields for type, description, children, data type, unit, min/max values, allowed values, and change type.

classes.name: DataEntry
classes.description: Internal representation of a data entry with specific types for data type, entry type, change type, description, comment, unit, min/max, allowed, and default values.

methods.name: try_from_json_array
methods.description: Converts a JSON array of values into an internal DataValue based on the specified data type.

methods.name: try_from_json_value
methods.description: Converts a single JSON value into an internal DataValue based on the specified data type.

methods.name: flatten_vss_tree
methods.description: Flattens the hierarchical VSS root entry into a map of full path strings to DataEntry objects.

methods.name: add_entry
methods.description: Recursively adds entries from the hierarchical structure into the flat map, constructing full paths.

methods.name: determine_change_type
methods.description: Determines the internal change type based on optional input and entry type, defaulting for attributes and others.

methods.name: parse_vss_from_reader
methods.description: Parses VSS data from a reader into a flat map of DataEntry objects.

methods.name: parse_vss_from_str
methods.description: Parses VSS data from a JSON string into a flat map of DataEntry objects.
